name: korea-data-mcp
description: Korean public data for AI agents: corporate filings and financials, stock prices, apartment trades, statutes and court rulings.
long_description: Free, official Korean data from OpenDART, data.go.kr and law.go.kr, with the traps that make agents give wrong answers already handled: half-year revenue reported as one quarter, statutes that include amendments not in force yet, cancelled apartment deals, district codes that changed in 2026. Each source needs its own free key; enter the ones you have, and tools for the others are not offered.

opendart_api_key.title: OpenDART API key
opendart_api_key.description: Corporate filings and financials. Free at opendart.fss.or.kr (인증키 신청).

datagokr_service_key.title: data.go.kr service key (Decoding)
datagokr_service_key.description: Holidays, corporations, business status, apartment trades, stock prices. Use the Decoding key from data.go.kr, and apply for each API (links in the README).

lawgokr_oc.title: law.go.kr OC
lawgokr_oc.description: Statutes and court rulings. Set at open.law.go.kr (마이페이지 > API인증키관리).
